scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace=@rebus/server
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace=@rebus/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
